paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Rav Ika: Berakhot 43b. He said to Rav Pappa, “Does the master not hold that the law follows the deciding opinion, which is Beit Shammai …?” Rav Pappa answered, “Thus said Rava: the law follows Beit Hillel.” This was not so; he did it to extricate himself. Rava had not said the law follows Beit Hillel; Rav Pappa was ashamed because he had erred and evaded it this way. Tosafot writes: Rav Alfasi rules like Rava, implying that his text did not contain “This was not so ….”
